heading: Monday
text: Breaks of sun in the morning then another chance of mid-day showers, chance of flurries in the mountains. More sun in the evening. Highs from the mid to upper 50s, low 60 in the broad valleys and southeast. Light wind becoming blustery northwest at 10 to 15 mph with 20 mph gusts.

heading: Monday Night
text: Chance of flurries northwest then partial clearing. Partly cloudy north, mostly clear south. Cooler. Lows in the mid to upper 20s. Northwest wind near 10 with 15 mph gusts.

heading: Tuesday
text: Clouds clearing before noon, becoming sunny. Chilly. Highs in the low to mid 30s, upper 30s in the broad valley and nearing 40 in the south. Northwest winds 5 to 10 mph gusting to 15 in the Champlain Valley.
